scenario: 给已有商品加一个规格值 — happy path
input: 给商品 13579 加一个 White 颜色，新变体卖 19.99

semantic_rubric: --option carries exactly the delta ("Color:White") — never the full value list of the dimension
price 19.99 verbatim from the utterance (new combos need a price)
no --sku-template / --stock invented — user never mentioned them

notes: Value add on an existing dimension: matched variants keep id/sku/stock; only White is created.

scenario: 加一个新规格维度 — 旧变体落到第一个值，必须先告知
input: 给商品 24680 加一个尺码规格，S、M、L 三个码

ask_must_cover: 第一个|首个|first|S 码|库存|stock
semantic_rubric: recognizes a NEW dimension name: existing variants keep their id/sku/stock and become the FIRST listed value (S); M and L are new variants with the price copied but no sku and zero stock — states this BEFORE any command
asks which size the current stock belongs to, so that value can be listed first
does NOT claim stock or prices are wiped — nothing existing is deleted
does NOT ask for --price — every new variant copies one
emits no write command until the user answers (ask-first)

notes: Ask-first case: adding a dimension pins existing variants to its first value (Shopify-style) and creates the other values with copied price, no sku/stock. The question that matters is which value the current stock belongs to.

scenario: 下掉一个规格值 — remove，变体会被删并报告
input: 把商品 13579 的 Pink 色下掉

semantic_rubric: --option carries only the value to drop ("Color:Pink") — a bare dimension name would drop the whole dimension
no --price: removal creates no variants
destructive delete → previews with --dry-run and waits for the user's go-ahead before the real run
after the real run, relays deleted_detail (id/sku/inventory)

notes: Removing a value deletes variants — safety protocol: dry-run + confirm first.

scenario: 建多规格商品 — 两步：+create 建草稿，再 +set-variants 加维度
input: 建一个瑜伽服商品，颜色有 Black/White/Pink，尺码 S/M，统一卖 29.99，图片用 https://cdn.example.com/yoga.jpg

semantic_rubric: two steps: products +create --price 29.99 (draft) first, then products +set-variants --id <new-id> --action add with BOTH dimensions (--option "Color:Black,White,Pink" --option "Size:S,M")
no --price needed on +set-variants: every combination copies the price +create set (passing it is harmless but unused)
does NOT hand-write a variants array on the products create leaf
publish only if the user asked to 上架 (they didn't — stays a draft)

notes: Multi-spec creation route: +create then +set-variants --action add. The created variant becomes the first combination; the rest copy its price.

scenario: 值集整体替换 — update，没列出的值会被删，先 dry-run + 确认
input: 商品 13579 的颜色只保留 Red 和 Blue

semantic_rubric: 只保留 → --action update with --option "Color:Red,Blue" (values not listed are removed) — not a series of removes
value spelling verbatim from the utterance
no --price: Red and Blue already exist, no new combos are created
destructive delete (unlisted values' variants) → previews with --dry-run and waits for the user's go-ahead before the real run
after the real run, relays which variants got deleted (deleted_detail)

notes: update replaces one dimension's value list; unlisted values' variants are deleted — same safety protocol as remove (case 03): dry-run + confirm first.

scenario: 规格值改名 — rename 原地改，变体全保留
input: 把商品 13579 的 Color 里的 Red 改名为 Wine Red

semantic_rubric: --option "Color:Red=Wine Red" — a rename pair, value spelling verbatim
does NOT model the rename as remove + add (that would delete the variants and lose sku/stock)
states that every variant keeps its id, sku and stock

notes: rename changes values in place: all variants keep their id. Non-destructive, so no dry-run/confirm round is required.
